description: sha256 of every network profile under scripts/alphartc/deploy/profiles: full_sha256 is the hash of the file as run (as recorded in provenance.json and in the runs' code hashes); body_sha256 is the hash of its command lines only (every line that is not empty and does not start with '#', each followed by a newline), so a profile rebuilt from the original traces can be checked even though its comment header differs. source is the trace corpus of the window; profiles from ucc_4g and norway_hsdpa are not distributed and must be rebuilt.
